The neighbourhood garbage rules
Ask neighbourhood head Mr. Sato about garbage days, times and the collection point; learn to ask questions and understand what is not allowed.
Meet neighbourhood head Mr. Sato
Ask about and remember the garbage days
Arrange to meet on Monday morning
I heard from Mr. Tanaka. He said a very polite new student had arrived.
You're the new student, right? I'll explain the neighbourhood's garbage rules.
Yes, please teach me.
Okay.
I don't like rules.
...I see. But the rules are for everyone. Please listen again.
Do you have any questions about putting out garbage?
When do I put out burnable garbage?
Garbage, when?
Where is the garbage?
Ask "moeru gomi wa, itsu desu ka". Remember to say the type of garbage too.
You're not asking about a place, you're asking about a day. Use "itsu". Ask again.
Burnable garbage is Monday and Thursday. Plastic bottles are Friday.
So, which day are plastic bottles?
Friday.
Thursday.
Could you say that once more, please?
Thursday is burnable garbage. Plastic bottles are Friday.
Yes. Burnable garbage on Monday and Thursday. Plastic bottles on Friday.
Please put your garbage out before eight in the morning.
Before eight in the morning. I understand.
Is it okay if I put it out at night?
I'll put it out at night. It'll be fine.
No, you can't. Please don't put garbage out at night. The crows will come.
That's not okay! Please don't put garbage out at night. The crows will come and make the whole street dirty.
Let me ask again. By what time must garbage be put out?
Before eight in the morning.
From eight in the morning.
Not "kara" but "made". Put it out before eight.
Please take your garbage to the collection point on that corner. Don't forget to put the net over it.
Yes, I won't forget.
Where is the net?
I don't like the net.
There's a green net next to the collection point. Please use it.
Without the net, crows pick through the garbage. It's really important.
The rules are for everyone. When the street is clean, everyone feels good, right?
Yes, a clean street feels nice.
I understand.
That's such a hassle.
...Even if it's a hassle, it's still important. Please think again.
Then next Monday morning, let's meet at the garbage collection point. We'll put the garbage out together.
Yes, Monday morning. Please show me how.
Yes, I'll come.
I'm busy on Monday.
I see. Then when is good? ...But Monday morning is garbage day. Let's do our best.
Yes, I'm counting on you. Ask me anything about this neighbourhood.
Summary: "~ wa itsu desu ka" (when is ~?), "~ nai de kudasai" (please don't ~), "~ made" (until/before ~). Remember: burnable garbage Monday and Thursday, plastic bottles Friday, out before 8 a.m.!
